jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 24e (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/swarm/core-1.mjs, tools/swarm/core-11.mjs, tools/wave-quarantine-types.mjs, tools/wave-quarantine.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/swarm/core-1.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm/core-1.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 80 `for (const dir of dirs) { try { await fs.access(path.join(dir, program)); return true; } catch { /* try the next dir */ } }`: SILENT-ENOENT (program not present in this PATH dir), log the rest; no fallback value, loop tries the next dir. ALSO stay silent for EACCES and ENOTDIR (odd PATH entries or a non-executable candidate are normal); log anything else.
- Line 236 `try { const event = JSON.parse(line); ... } catch { /* not a JSON event line */ }`: SILENT-SyntaxError (a stdout line from the CLI that isn't a JSON event), log the rest; no fallback value, loop continues to the next line.

Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/swarm/core-11.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)

ALSO stay silent for EACCES and ENOTDIR (odd PATH entries or a non-executable candidate are normal); log anything else.
- Line 490 `} catch { /* no TASK.md, or nothing queued: no hint */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT (TASK.md not present), log the rest; keep `hint = null` fallback.

### tools/wave-quarantine-types.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/wave-quarantine-types.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 189 `await fs.unlink(tmp).catch(() => {});`: cleanup catch in an error path that rethrows the original error (`throw error;` on the next line) — LOG-ALWAYS with a different binding, include the tmp path; no fallback value, best-effort unlink. EXCEPTION: stay silent for error?.code === 'ENOENT' (tmp may never have been created); log anything else.
- Line 263 `const stat = await fs.stat(fromAbs).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (ticket's declared output file was never created), log the rest; keep null fallback (guarded by `if (!stat?.isFile()) continue`).

EXCEPTION: stay silent for error?.code === 'ENOENT' (tmp may never have been created); log anything else.
- Line 142 `const stat = await fs.stat(fromAbs).catch(() => null);`: SILENT-ENOENT (ticket's declared output file was never created), log the rest; keep null fallback (guarded by `if (!stat?.isFile()) continue`).

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.
